title: After the 09/10/2026 re-release, what Tracy seals a new site with agrees with the Claude Cowork plugin and the release: ja-essence/j6/1.0.3 is the contract the plugin carries, JA Voyara is pinned at 1.0.5 on Claude Cowork 0.24.6 or later with its own contract files, and JA Kinetic 1.0.4 has a current demo-trim map hiding its 241 demo posts; Kinetic is pinned at 1.0.4 on Claude Cowork 0.24.7 or later, which carries that map; JA Trip 1.0.4, Spa 1.0.2 and Space 1.0.3 are pinned on Claude Cowork 0.24.8 or later with their own contract files; JA Voyara 1.0.6 and JA Spa 1.0.3 and 1.0.4 have profiles of their own (content map unchanged, lock differing only in the hashes of the files the release changed), so no publish warns LOWER_CONTRACT
steps: S2: the ja-voyara entry of both quickstarts.json and both design-templates.json.
S4: pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-all.ts --only contracts --only design-templates --only quickstart-overrides --only joomla-demo-trim.
S5: the ja-kinetic entry of both quickstarts.json and both design-templates.json.
S6: the ja-trip, ja-spa and ja-space entries of both quickstarts.json.
S7: ja-voyara/j6/1.0.6, ja-spa/j6/1.0.3 and ja-spa/j6/1.0.4 against the previous profile (1.0.5, 1.0.2, 1.0.3); contractStatus and contractWarnings of a build at each version.
expect: S1: the three hashes are those Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.5 and 0.24.6 carry (fbd41349…, 836b332e…, 0d78fe39…).

S2: version 1.0.5 or later (the same in both catalogues), contract ja-voyara/j6/<that version>, Claude Cowork 0.24.6 or later, every pinned contract file hash equal to the tch file's; both design registries at base <that version> and profile ja-voyara/j6/<that version>.
S3: the map names ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.4, hides 241 articles, and --check exits 0.

S5: 1.0.8 (first pinned at 1.0.4 on 0.24.7), Claude Cowork 0.24.36 or later, the pin's demo-trim-map.json hash equal to tch's 1.0.8 map; both design registries at profile ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.8 with coworkMinVersion 0.24.36.

S6: trip 1.0.4, spa 1.0.2, space 1.0.3 or later (the pin follows each release), each on its own webroot and database files, contract <slug>/j6/<version>, Claude Cowork 0.24.8 or later, every pinned contract file hash (its own and each version it also carries) equal to the tch file's.

S7: manifest id and release parts name the version; content-map.json and the design sidecar are the previous profile's byte for byte; the lock outside `files` is the previous one's and the locked paths are the same; exactly the files each release's VERIFICATION.json lists as changed have a new hash; contractStatus is exact on the profile of that version and contractWarnings is empty; the plugin floor and the manifest's coworkContractVersion are 0.24.16 (the release that carries the three profiles), no coworkContractPending remains, both quickstarts.json pin a plugin at or above it and coworkPinFor answers for each version with that pin.

selectors.pins: apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json, apps/tracy-web/src/design-templates.json and their fleet copies

fence: What this repository seals and pins.
